---
title: "quarto-webmcp example"
description: "Every page on this site registers WebMCP tools that answer questions about the site and its posts."
---

This site is built with the [quarto-webmcp](https://github.com/alexanderwiebe/quarto-webmcp) extension.
Open it in a browser with WebMCP and an agent can ask the page for its content instead of reading the screen.

## Try it

In any browser, open the developer console and run:

```js
window.siteTools.list().map(t => t.name)
JSON.parse(await window.siteTools.call('about_this_website', {}))
```

`<html data-webmcp>` shows whether the tools were registered with WebMCP.
